empty.noHeartRate: No heart rate data: set your max HR in your profile and import sessions with heart rate.
empty.noGps: No running GPS track in this period: best efforts are computed from tracks (Strava or GPX).
empty.noWellness: No recovery data: connect Open Wearables (sleep, HRV, resting HR). If your watch doesn't provide a metric, its chart stays hidden.

fitness.title: Fitness over time
fitness.description: Fitness (CTL, 42 d), fatigue (ATL, 7 d) and form (TSB = CTL − ATL), with each day’s load.
fitness.chartLabel: CTL, ATL, TSB and daily load chart
fitness.methods: Load computed from: HR {hr} sessions, pace {pace}, perceived effort {rpe}
fitness.estimated: Load mostly estimated from perceived effort: set your max HR for better accuracy

intensity.title: Intensity distribution
intensity.description: Time spent in each zone per week. Benchmark: about 80 % in Z1–Z2.
intensity.recentLowShare: {percent} % of time in Z1–Z2 over 4 weeks:
intensity.tooGrey: too much time in the middle zone

performance.title: Performance
performance.description: Best efforts measured within your sessions, derived VDOT and race predictions.
performance.vdotHint: Best efforts of the last 90 days

efficiency.title: Aerobic efficiency
efficiency.description: Speed / HR on easy runs: an increase is the best sign of aerobic progress. Decoupling: pace/HR drift on long runs (< 5 % = solid base).

recovery.title: Recovery
recovery.description: HRV, resting HR and sleep compared with your baselines.
recovery.hrvLow: HRV below your normal range for {days} days: consider easing off.

signals.respiratory_rate_high: Unusual overnight respiratory rate: possible onset of illness, take it easy today.
signals.resting_hr_high: Resting HR well above your normal.

report.title: Summary for Claude and export
report.description: A compact Markdown block of the metrics computed by Sporty, to paste into your Claude project.
report.privacy: Your health data only leaves Sporty through these exports, to you.

map.title: Map of my tracks
map.description: {count} overlaid tracks: your favourite routes stand out by accumulation. Click a track to open the session.

compare.title: Session comparison
compare.gapHint: Time gap (s) versus the first session at the same kilometre: negative = ahead.
